title: New Year's Countdown
intro: [excited] Ten, nine, eight... welcome to the New Year's episode of Disney Jeopardy! Tonight is all about firsts, lasts and big grand finales. [laughs] Grab a noisemaker!

art.prompt: A celebratory night sky over a fairy-tale castle with gold and silver fireworks, confetti and streamers falling, a giant ornate clock face showing nearly midnight, party hats and noisemakers on a table, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: First Frames
categories.intro: First, Disney movie firsts. [chuckles] Somebody had to go first!

art.prompt: A vintage film studio: an old animation desk with a pencil sketch of a blank page, a film reel, a hand-crank camera, a glowing 'first light' spotlight hitting a blank movie screen, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Toy Story, released in 1995, was the first feature film made entirely with this technology.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is computer animation! Pixar made history. [excited] To infinity and beyond!

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse spoke his very first words in 1929's The Karnival Kid. What were they?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is hot dogs! [laughs] Mickey's first words were a snack order.

clues.clue: This 2013 film was the first from Walt Disney Animation Studios to win the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen! Pixar had won before, but this was Disney Animation's first. [excited] Let it go!

clues.clue: Premiering in 1997, this Halloween movie about a mummy is considered the first Disney Channel Original Movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Under Wraps! A friendly mummy named Harold. [chuckles] Long before High School Musical.

clues.clue: Released in 1985, this was the first Disney animated feature to get a PG rating.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Black Cauldron! [gasps] The Horned King scared a whole generation.

categories.title: Grand Finales
categories.intro: Next, the nighttime spectaculars that end a Disney day. [excited] Find a spot and look up!

art.prompt: A lagoon at night with fireworks reflecting in the water, a mist screen glowing with color, a floating globe of lights, and a parade of glowing floats along a riverbank, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This Magic Kingdom fireworks show, which debuted in 2017, has a fairy-tale-ending title.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Happily Ever After! [sighs] Hold on to someone you love for this one.

clues.clue: In this Disneyland nighttime show, Mickey battles villains including Maleficent as a giant dragon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fantasmic! [excited] Some imagination, huh?

clues.clue: This EPCOT finale, which ran from 1999 to 2019, featured a giant globe that opened like a flower.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is IllumiNations: Reflections of Earth! [sighs] Twenty years of World Showcase goosebumps.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Wishes fireworks, which ran from 2003 to 2017, was narrated by this character.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jiminy Cricket! [whispers] When you wish upon a star...

clues.clue: Disneyland's original Main Street Electrical Parade debuted in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1972! Baroque Hoedown, forever. [laughs] Now it's stuck in your head.

categories.title: Last Call
categories.intro: Now, the last rides. Attractions that closed their doors for good. [sighs] Pour one out.

art.prompt: A shuttered ride entrance at dusk with a closed velvet rope, a chained gate, dust sheets over a ride vehicle, a single flickering lamp and a 'closed' sandwich board with no writing, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Ellen's Energy Adventure, which closed at EPCOT in 2017, starred this talk show host.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ellen DeGeneres! With Bill Nye and a lot of dinosaurs. [laughs] Forty-five minutes of energy.

clues.clue: Michael Jackson starred in this 3D space musical film shown at the parks.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Captain EO! Directed by Francis Ford Coppola. [excited] Produced by George Lucas!

clues.clue: Frozen Ever After replaced this Viking boat ride in EPCOT's Norway pavilion in 2016.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maelstrom! Trolls, polar bears and a backwards plunge. [whispers] Then Elsa moved in.

clues.clue: Disney's Hollywood Studios closed this ride in 2017; Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway took over its building.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Great Movie Ride! Its home is a copy of a famous Hollywood theater. [sighs] We still miss the gangster shootout.

clues.clue: This futuristic EPCOT ride, which let guests choose their own ending, closed in 1999.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Horizons! Desert, sea or space. [sighs] If we had a time machine, we'd ride it again.

categories.title: Fade to Black
categories.intro: Picture time! Every picture is a final scene from a Disney or Pixar film. [whispers] Spoilers ahead. Name the movie.

art.prompt: A darkening movie screen with the last golden light fading, curtains slowly closing, an empty popcorn bucket and an old projector winding down in a cozy theater, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The final scene of which film? Hint: a new cub is presented to the whole kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Lion King! The circle of life comes full circle. [excited] Everybody sing!

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A jutting rocky promontory at sunrise over an African savanna, herds of zebras, elephants and antelope gathered below looking up, warm golden light, clouds parting

clues.clue: The final scene of which film? Hint: a balloon-lifted house finally reaches its waterfall.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Up! Carl's house finally sits right where Ellie dreamed. [sighs] Pass the tissues.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A small colorful wooden house resting on a cliff edge beside a tall waterfall in a misty South American tablelands landscape, a few loose balloons drifting away

clues.clue: The final scene of which film? Hint: a queen turns her castle courtyard into a summer ice rink.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen! The castle courtyard becomes an ice rink. [laughs] Summer, but make it skating.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A Nordic castle courtyard in bright summer sunshine magically turned into an outdoor ice skating rink, sparkling frost patterns, a frozen fountain, snowflakes drifting, open castle gates

clues.clue: The final scene of which film? Hint: a shredded closet door is rebuilt so a big blue monster can say hello again.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Monsters, Inc.! The door is rebuilt, one splinter at a time. [whispers] Kitty?

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A single pink closet door decorated with painted flowers standing on a door station in a vast industrial factory, rebuilt from splintered pieces with one last wood sliver placed on a nearby workbench

clues.clue: The final scene of which film? Hint: a nanny floats away by umbrella as the family flies kites.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mary Poppins! Kites in the park, and an umbrella sailing off over London. [sighs] The wind changed.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Colorful kites flying over a sunny Edwardian London park, while an open black umbrella with a carved parrot-head handle floats away over chimney-filled rooftops

categories.title: Tick-Tock Clocks
categories.intro: Finally, it's almost midnight, so this category is all about clocks! [excited] Tick, tock, contestants.

art.prompt: A collection of antique clocks on a wall: a grandfather clock, a mantel clock, a cuckoo clock, a pocket watch and a giant tower clock face in the window, all hands pointing near midnight, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Cinderella's magic spell ends at the stroke of this hour.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is midnight! [gasps] Run, Cinderella! Leave a shoe, it's fine.

clues.clue: In Peter Pan, Captain Hook is chased by a crocodile that swallowed one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a clock! Tick-Tock the Crocodile. [laughs] Also, he ate Hook's hand.

clues.clue: In Beauty and the Beast, the castle's head of household was turned into this mantel clock.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cogsworth! [chuckles] If it's not baroque, don't fix it.

clues.clue: At Disneyland, the clock tower on the it's a small world facade launches a parade of toys this often.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is every fifteen minutes! [excited] Wooden soldiers, dolls, everybody marches out.

clues.clue: In The Great Mouse Detective, Basil battles Ratigan at the climax inside this London clock tower.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Ben! Gears, pendulums and one very mean rat. [gasps] Hang on, Basil!
